obligations.title: Add the duty: Book every transaction on the day it is concluded
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, RelV-FINMA (SR 952.024.1), Art. 6, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2020

titles.en: Book every transaction on the day it is concluded

summaries.en: A bank, securities firm, financial group or financial conglomerate must record all transactions concluded on a day on that same day. Spot transactions concluded but not yet settled are recorded on the trade date or the settlement date, and the method may differ by product category.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value impaired receivables one by one at liquidation value and build individual value adjustments
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, RelV-FINMA (SR 952.024.1), Art. 24, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2020

titles.en: Value impaired receivables one by one at liquidation value and build individual value adjustments

summaries.en: A receivable is impaired where it is unlikely that the debtor can meet its future obligations, signs of which include serious financial difficulty, actual breach of contract, concessions made because of the debtor's difficulties, likely bankruptcy or restructuring, earlier impairment and past collection experience. Impaired receivables are valued individually, with individual value adjustments, at liquidation value together with any collateral and taking the debtor's creditworthiness into account; homogeneous portfolios of many small receivables may be assessed as a whole. Where repayment depends solely on realising the collateral, the uncovered part is written down in full.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build value adjustments for default risk on receivables that are not impaired by the method of the bank's category and explain it in the notes
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, RelV-FINMA (SR 952.024.1), Art. 25 Abs. 1, 4, 5 und 8, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2020

titles.en: Build value adjustments for default risk on receivables that are not impaired by the method of the bank's category and explain it in the notes

summaries.en: A bank must build value adjustments for default risks on receivables that are not impaired: banks of categories 1 and 2 for expected losses, category 3 banks mainly active in interest business for inherent default risks, and other banks and securities firms for latent default risks. A bank that applies no recognised international accounting standard determines expected losses on long-run average estimates over the remaining term for receivables from banks and customers, mortgage receivables and held-to-maturity debt securities. It must explain in the notes to the accounts the methods, data and assumptions used, and disclose there any shortfall that arises from using such value adjustments for individual ones.

titles.en: FINMA Financial Institutions Ordinance

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run an internal control system built on a systematic risk analysis and set the risk tolerance against risk-bearing capacity
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FINIV-FINMA (SR 954.111), Art. 8, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2021

titles.en: Run an internal control system built on a systematic risk analysis and set the risk tolerance against risk-bearing capacity

summaries.en: A manager of collective assets must have an internal control system based on a systematic risk analysis, with control activities built into its work processes. Its body for direction, supervision and control, or its management body where it has no such body, ensures through that system and its oversight that all material risks are identified, assessed, steered and monitored, and sets the risk tolerance in the light of the manager's capacity to bear risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Lay down risk management and control in internal directives, with internal liquidity thresholds for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FINIV-FINMA (SR 954.111), Art. 11, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2021

titles.en: Lay down risk management and control in internal directives, with internal liquidity thresholds for each fund

summaries.en: A manager of collective assets must lay down appropriate principles and the organisation of risk management and risk control in internal directives that cover the risks of its whole business and of the collective and mandate assets it manages. The directives set the responsibilities, the kinds of risk, the procedures and systems for assessing and managing all material risks, market, liquidity and counterparty risk in particular, and the reporting to the supervisory and management bodies, in proportion to the nature, size and complexity of the business. For each collective investment scheme it defines appropriate internal liquidity thresholds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep risk control staffed, independent and apart from portfolio management
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FINIV-FINMA (SR 954.111), Art. 14, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Januar 2021

titles.en: Keep risk control staffed, independent and apart from portfolio management

summaries.en: A manager of collective assets must have enough qualified staff for risk control, who identify, assess and monitor the risks the manager takes, the risk of each position and the overall risk of the schemes and pension assets it manages, and the risks of other mandates. Risk control must be separated by function and hierarchy from the operating units, in particular from portfolio management, and must be able to act independently.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a journal of every order and trade with the prescribed details in a standard form
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FinfraV-FINMA (SR 958.111), Art. 1, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Februar 2023

titles.en: Keep a journal of every order and trade with the prescribed details in a standard form

summaries.en: Securities firms and participants admitted to a trading venue must record the orders and trades they are obliged to record in a journal, whether or not the securities or derivatives are traded on a venue. For each order the journal shows the instrument, the time received, the client, the kind of business and order and the size, and for each trade the time and size of execution, the price, the place of execution, the counterparty and the value date. Orders and trades are recorded in a standard form so that FINMA can be given complete information at once on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each trade with the prescribed details to the trading venue where the security is admitted, within the venue's deadline
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FinfraV-FINMA (SR 958.111), Art. 2 bis 4 und Art. 5 Abs. 1 bis 3, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Februar 2023

titles.en: Report each trade with the prescribed details to the trading venue where the security is admitted, within the venue's deadline

summaries.en: Securities firms and participants admitted to a trading venue must report each reportable trade to the reporting office of the trading venue where the security, or for a derivative the underlying, is admitted to trading, choosing one where there are several, within the deadline the venue's rules set. The report states the reporting firm, buy or sell, the exact instrument with the underlying and features of a derivative, the size, the price and further value parameters of a derivative, date and time, own account or client, the counterparty, the venue or off-venue execution and, for client trades, a standard reference that identifies the beneficial owner.

payload.refLabel: Art. 2 bis 4 und Art. 5 Abs. 1 bis 3

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify a shareholding that reaches, crosses or falls below a threshold to the company and the disclosure office within four trading days
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, FinfraV-FINMA (SR 958.111), Art. 13 Abs. 1, Art. 19, Art. 22 Abs. 1 und Art. 24 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. Februar 2023

titles.en: Notify a shareholding that reaches, crosses or falls below a threshold to the company and the disclosure office within four trading days

summaries.en: The duty to notify a shareholding arises when the claim to acquire or dispose of equity securities is created, conditional or not. The notification gives, among the other details the ordinance lists, the voting share, the kind and number of securities and derivatives held and their voting rights, the event that triggered it and the dates, and must reach the company and the competent disclosure office within four trading days, or twenty after an inheritance. A bank or securities firm may leave out of its positions equity securities and derivatives held in its trading book, through securities lending, transfers by way of security or repos, each below 5 per cent of the voting rights, or for settlement for at most two trading days, provided it does not intend to exercise the votes or influence management and the total stays at or below 10 per cent.

titles.en: As custodian bank, report securities loans to the fund, settle lending income monthly and monitor the collateral

summaries.en: In settling securities lending for a fund, the custodian bank must inform the fund management company or SICAV regularly about the loans made, account for the lending income at least once a month, ensure safe settlement in line with the contract and monitor in particular that the collateral requirements are met. During the loans it carries on the administrative acts its custody rules require and asserts all rights on the lent securities, unless they were assigned under the standard framework agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As custodian bank, settle a fund's repos safely and have changes in value margined every day

titles.en: As custodian bank, settle a fund's repos safely and have changes in value margined every day

summaries.en: In settling repurchase agreements for a fund, the custodian bank must ensure safe settlement in line with the contract and that changes in the value of the securities used are offset every day in cash or securities (mark-to-market). During the transaction it carries on the administrative acts its custody rules require and asserts all rights on the securities used, unless they were assigned under the standard framework agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the risk and capital tables the bank's category requires, clearly and consistently, and keep four years online
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, OffV-FINMA (SR 952.022.2), Art. 3 und Art. 4 Abs. 1, 2, 4 und 6, consolidated German text, Stand am 24. September 2026

titles.en: Publish the risk and capital tables the bank's category requires, clearly and consistently, and keep four years online

summaries.en: A bank's disclosures must be clear, appropriate, meaningful and consistent from period to period, with material changes explained; information without meaning is left out and the reason documented internally. Their scope depends on the bank's category, its systemic importance and its capital approaches as set in the annexes, and every bank publishes at least the key metrics, the overview of risk-weighted positions, the credit risk, operational risk, interest rate risk and liquidity tables named in the ordinance and the corporate governance information, with more for systemically important banks and for banks that must hold 10 billion francs of minimum capital. Disclosures for the four preceding years must stay published, apart from the governance and systemic-importance annexes.

titles.en: Publish yearly disclosures within four months of the annual accounts and interim disclosures within two months

summaries.en: A bank must publish the data updated for each annual period within four months of closing its annual accounts; the remuneration disclosure may be delayed by at most two further months where the date of the general meeting does not allow four. Data updated for an interim period are published within two months of its end, and the date on which the published information was prepared or changed must be stated clearly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze funds and economic resources of listed persons and of those acting for or owned by them
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 15 Abs. 1, 2ter und 2quater, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Freeze funds and economic resources of listed persons and of those acting for or owned by them

summaries.en: Funds and economic resources owned or controlled by the persons, companies and organisations listed in Annex 8, by those acting on their behalf or at their direction, and by companies and organisations they own or control, are frozen. Interest and other income on frozen accounts, payments under existing contracts, payments under arbitral awards or court or authority decisions given or enforceable in Switzerland, the EEA or the United Kingdom, and funds that third parties transfer to a listed person may be credited to frozen accounts only if the amounts credited are frozen as well; SECO may allow payments from frozen accounts in the exceptional cases the ordinance lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds or economic resources available to listed persons, directly or indirectly
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 15 Abs. 2 und 3, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Make no funds or economic resources available to listed persons, directly or indirectly

summaries.en: It is prohibited to transfer funds to the listed persons, companies and organisations whose assets are frozen, or to make funds or economic resources available to them in any other way, directly or indirectly. The prohibition does not apply where a transfer is needed for humanitarian activities or support of the civilian population in connection with the situation in Ukraine by public bodies or federally funded organisations, or for official activities of Swiss diplomatic and consular missions and federal missions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds to SECO without delay and their amounts every year by 15 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 16, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Report frozen funds to SECO without delay and their amounts every year by 15 February

summaries.en: Anyone who holds or manages funds, or knows of funds or economic resources, that must be assumed to fall under the freeze must report them to SECO without delay, with the beneficiaries' names and the subject and value of the frozen assets; credits of third-party transfers to frozen accounts are reported without delay with the names of the senders. A financial institution that has reported funds it holds or manages sends SECO every year by 15 February the amounts as at 31 December of the previous year. For persons newly added to Annex 8 it reports all transactions of the two weeks before the listing without delay, and transfers received under the exception for listed sending or intermediary banks are reported every quarter.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept no deposits above 100,000 francs from Russian nationals, residents or Russian companies
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 20 Abs. 1 und 3, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Accept no deposits above 100,000 francs from Russian nationals, residents or Russian companies

summaries.en: A firm that takes deposits and grants loans commercially may not accept deposits from Russian nationals, natural persons resident in Russia, banks, companies or organisations established in Russia, or non-Swiss and non-EEA entities more than half owned by such persons, where the total deposits per person or entity exceed 100,000 francs. The ban does not apply to Swiss, EEA or United Kingdom nationals or to persons with a residence permit of Switzerland, an EEA state or the United Kingdom, and SECO may grant exceptions for the purposes the ordinance lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide no crypto, payment instrument, payment processing or e-money services to Russian nationals, residents or Russian companies
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 20 Abs. 2, 2bis, 3 und 3bis, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Provide no crypto, payment instrument, payment processing or e-money services to Russian nationals, residents or Russian companies

summaries.en: It is prohibited to provide commercially, directly or indirectly, crypto services, the issue of payment instruments, the acceptance and settlement of payment transactions or payment initiation, or the issue of e-money to Russian nationals, natural persons resident in Russia or legal persons and organisations established there, or to let Russian nationals or residents own, control or sit on the management of a Swiss or EEA crypto service provider. Swiss, EEA and United Kingdom nationals and holders of a residence permit there are excepted, as is providing personalised security features needed to access an account in Switzerland, the EEA or a partner state.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits above 100,000 francs of Russian nationals, residents and Russian companies to SECO every twelve months
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen im Zusammenhang mit der Situation in der Ukraine (SR 946.231.176.72), Art. 21, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Report deposits above 100,000 francs of Russian nationals, residents and Russian companies to SECO every twelve months

summaries.en: A firm that takes deposits and grants loans commercially must give SECO current information every twelve months on the amount of deposits above 100,000 francs held by Russian nationals, natural persons resident in Russia and banks, companies or organisations established in Russia. obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 12 Abs. 1, 2quater und 2quinquies, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Freeze funds and economic resources of listed persons and of those acting for or owned by them

summaries.en: Funds and economic resources owned or controlled by the persons, companies and organisations listed in Annex 13, by those acting on their behalf or at their direction, and by companies and organisations they own or control, are frozen. Interest and other income on frozen accounts, payments under existing contracts, payments under arbitral awards or court or authority decisions given or enforceable in Switzerland, the EEA or the United Kingdom, and funds that third parties transfer to a listed person may be credited to frozen accounts only if the amounts credited are frozen as well; SECO may allow payments from frozen accounts in the exceptional cases the ordinance lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds or economic resources available to listed persons, directly or indirectly
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 12 Abs. 2 und 2ter, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Make no funds or economic resources available to listed persons, directly or indirectly

summaries.en: It is prohibited to transfer funds to the listed persons, companies and organisations whose assets are frozen, or to make funds or economic resources available to them in any other way, directly or indirectly. The prohibition does not apply where a transfer is needed for humanitarian activities by public bodies or by organisations that receive federal funding for them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report frozen funds to SECO without delay and their amounts every year by 15 February
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 13, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Report frozen funds to SECO without delay and their amounts every year by 15 February

summaries.en: Anyone who holds or manages funds, or knows of funds or economic resources, that must be assumed to fall under the freeze must report them to SECO without delay, with the beneficiaries' names and the subject and value of the frozen assets; credits of third-party transfers to frozen accounts are reported without delay with the names of the senders. A financial institution that has reported funds it holds or manages sends SECO every year by 15 February the amounts as at 31 December of the previous year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept no deposits above 100,000 francs from Belarusian nationals, residents or Belarusian companies
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 18 Abs. 1 und 2, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Accept no deposits above 100,000 francs from Belarusian nationals, residents or Belarusian companies

summaries.en: A firm that takes deposits and grants loans commercially may not accept deposits from Belarusian nationals, natural persons resident in Belarus, banks, companies or organisations established in Belarus, or non-Swiss and non-EEA entities more than 50 per cent owned by such persons, where the total deposits per person or entity exceed 100,000 francs. The ban does not apply to Swiss, EEA or United Kingdom nationals or to holders of a residence permit of Switzerland, an EEA state or the United Kingdom, and SECO may grant exceptions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide no crypto, payment instrument, payment processing or e-money services to Belarusian nationals, residents or Belarusian companies
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 18 Abs. 1bis, 1ter, 2 und 2bis, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Provide no crypto, payment instrument, payment processing or e-money services to Belarusian nationals, residents or Belarusian companies

summaries.en: It is prohibited to provide commercially, directly or indirectly, crypto services, the issue of payment instruments, the acceptance and settlement of payment transactions or payment initiation, or the issue of e-money to Belarusian nationals, natural persons resident in Belarus or legal persons and organisations established there, or to let Belarusian nationals or residents own, control or sit on the management of a Swiss or EEA crypto service provider. Swiss, EEA and United Kingdom nationals and holders of a residence permit there are excepted, as is providing personalised security features needed to access an account in Switzerland, the EEA or a partner state.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report deposits above 100,000 francs of Belarusian nationals, residents and Belarusian companies to SECO every twelve months
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber Belarus (SR 946.231.116.9), Art. 19, consolidated German text, Stand am 5. November 2026

titles.en: Report deposits above 100,000 francs of Belarusian nationals, residents and Belarusian companies to SECO every twelve months

summaries.en: A bank or a person licensed under Article 1b of the Banking Act must give SECO current information every twelve months on the amount of deposits above 100,000 francs held by Belarusian nationals, natural persons resident in Belarus and banks, companies or organisations established in Belarus. The first list was due by 3 June 2022.

obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea (SR 946.231.127.6), Art. 9 Abs. 1, 2, 6 und 7, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. November 2026

titles.en: Freeze funds and economic resources of listed persons, of those acting for or owned by them, and listed vessels

summaries.en: Funds and economic resources owned or controlled by the persons, companies and organisations listed in Annex 1, by those acting on their behalf or at their direction, and by companies and organisations they own or control, are frozen, as are the vessels listed in Annex 6. Interest and other income on frozen accounts, payments under existing contracts and funds that third parties transfer to a listed person may be credited to frozen accounts only if the amounts credited are frozen as well.

Freezing and the prohibition do not apply where transfers or resources are needed for humanitarian aid or other activities meeting basic human needs by the United Nations, international and humanitarian organisations and the other bodies the ordinance names. Funds may not be made available to the listed vessels either.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide no financial services linked to prohibited activities and keep no correspondent, joint venture or ownership ties with North Korean banks
obligations.sourceLabel: Fedlex, Verordnung über Massnahmen gegenüber der Demokratischen Volksrepublik Korea (SR 946.231.127.6), Art. 10, Art. 11 Abs. 2 und Art. 12 Abs. 1, consolidated German text, Stand am 1. November 2026

titles.en: Provide no financial services linked to prohibited activities and keep no correspondent, joint venture or ownership ties with North Korean banks

summaries.en: It is prohibited to provide financial services, clearing included, connected with activities the ordinance prohibits. A financial institution in Switzerland may not form joint ventures with North Korean banks, acquire holdings in them, or establish or maintain correspondent relationships with them, and Swiss banks may not open or run branches, subsidiaries, representative offices or bank accounts in North Korea; SECO may grant exceptions only after approval by the competent UN Security Council committee.
